segments.text: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.

footnotes.text: + merciful…: Heb. men of kindness, or, godliness
+ from…: or, from that which is evil

segments.text: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: ¶ But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

segments.speaker: The people
segments.text: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?

segments.speaker: The people
segments.text: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

segments.speaker: The people
segments.text: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

segments.speaker: The people
segments.text: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.

footnotes.text: + made…: or, hewed it for thyself larger than theirs

segments.speaker: The people
segments.text: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.

segments.speaker: The people
segments.text: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope:
thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.

¶ When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
And shall say,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy;

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near,
saith the LORD;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: and I will heal him.
But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: There is no peace,
saith my God,

segments.speaker: My God
segments.text: to the wicked.
